# Pin for the Python half of the spec codegen pipeline (ADR §3.2):
# datamodel-code-generator renders src/packages/contract/sidecar/openapi.yaml
# into Pydantic v2 models at src/sidecars/ar/generated/models.py.
#
# Exact pin on purpose — the generated file is committed and CI regenerates
# + `git diff --exit-code`s it, so generator-version drift must be an
# explicit edit here, never ambient. Run via scripts/generate-sidecar-models.sh
# (uvx), the same command CI runs.
#
# The sibling requirements.lock pins the generator's FULL transitive
# closure (regenerate with:
#   uv pip compile src/sidecars/ar/codegen/requirements.txt --universal \
#     --python-version 3.12 -o src/sidecars/ar/codegen/requirements.lock
# ). generate-sidecar-models.sh feeds it to uvx via --with-requirements, so
# both codegen halves are symmetrically reproducible (PR #27 review).
datamodel-code-generator==0.66.3
